0.text: <c=pc>Sicilus:</c> $NAME! I suppose you’re wondering what Tinny and I are doing here, out in the cold.

1.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c> Freezing our backsides off that’s what! *hic*

0.text: <c=pc>Sicilus:</c> Markos sent us to find you. Figured we might be of some use.

1.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c> Chances are that bastard Roma is dabbling in dark magicks. Magicks that’ll take our combined efforts to vanquish, deary!

2.text: <c=pc>Sicilus:</c> Those blasted Order forbid runespeak for the rest of us. Meanwhile they dabble and call it “divine intervention”.

0.text: Roma cast a barrier around the ruins.
<c=pc>Tinny:</c> *hic* Those aren’t just any ruins! They’re the remains of Khabor’s Waystation, where the portal between worlds once hummed!

1.text: <c=pc>Sicilus:</c>  If I can interject - A magick barrier is more than just mysticism. They were invented by the Janists, a combination of runespeak and science. They’re nigh impenetrable!

2.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c> Now, now, settle down Sicilus. There may still be a way.

0.text: Whatever it is, I’ll do it.
<c=pc>Tinny:</c> Not far from here lies the chilly *hic* waters of Narwhal Bay…

1.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c> The horn of a Narwhal is powerful $NAME, like nothing you’ve ever seen before. With the right ritual, it can become an explosive weapon of great force.

2.text: <c=pc>Sicilus:</c> Head to the bay, find one of these beasts, kill it and bring its horn back to us. We will conquer this barrier yet!

0.text: <c=pc>Sicilus:</c> Thank the gods you’re back. Tinny here is driving me mad!

1.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c> You’re not so fun yourself Sicilus.

2.text: <c=pc>Sicilus:</c> *sigh* Enough about us. What happened in there? Is the horn blessed?

0.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c>  What? What happened? What did you see?
A man. Sephotep he was called.

2.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c> ….an agent of supreme darkness…. *hic* What was he doing so close to our realm?

0.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c> He’s a boogeyman to all witches and warlocks. A man once… *hic* He made a deal with something *hic* otherworldly. Now, his mind has been opened too far. He travels the astral planes, causing chaos and horror wherever he goes...

1.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c> We’ll deal with this later. Right now *hic* you need to stop Roma, dearie. Return to the Waystation and find out what he’s doing before it’s too late!

0.text: <c=pc>Sicilus:</c> You need to use the horn to destroy the barrier. Stab the horn deep into the barrier crystals the Order is using to keep their barrier stable.

1.text: <c=pc>Tinny:</c> You must hurry *hic* before the blessing is gone!
